residual_risks: The review did not re-run the browser flow end-to-end, so the remaining risk is integration-only: real presigned uploads against the active storage adapter/CORS config could still fail even though the SPA caller and test contract are consistent.

The hook still hard-codes application/octet-stream for both FIT and GPX in apps/web/src/pages/workouts/new/use-workout-entry.ts. That matches the current API contract, but any future tightening of content-type validation on POST /workouts/source/presign would need a coordinated web update.
